observations: A previously pending publication criterion can be evaluated using later exact-head CI and main readback while keeping the earlier matrix and verdicts immutable.
Assess the original Entry's explicit success conditions separately from a broader ongoing primary objective. A truthful boundedPASS does not imply authority to stop the primary.
Separate live CI tracking from fields changed by the incoming publication so heartbeat writes do not recreate an already observed merge conflict; no new unverified Candidate is needed.
